text:
Priya: Drafting the release notes for the docs push on Thursday. Main items: embeddings migration guide fix, small SDK snippet rename (jsClient -> client), and a couple of broken internal links found by CI. Need signoff on wording and which examples to include.

Ben: I caught the embed example failing in the integration tests. Old example used `jsClient.embed()` which now errors with 422: "unsupported method". I pushed a tiny fix in my branch but haven't opened the PR yet.

Claire: Can you paste the failing example? I want to make sure the relnotes show the recommended replacement.

Ben: Failing code: `const resp = await jsClient.embed('text') // -> 422 unsupported method` Suggested doc replacement: `const resp = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'rwd-embed-2', input: 'text' })`

Tom: For relnotes length, let's keep the examples minimal. One JS + one Python snippet is enough. Add a link to the full migration guide for diffs.

docs-bot: LinkCheck: 2 broken anchors discovered: guides/migration/embedding.md#legacy vs new path migration/embedding-v2.md#legacy-embeddings.

Priya: Okay we need three actions: update the embedding snippet (Ben), update internal link + add redirect (Claire), and produce a concise known-issues bullet about old SDKs returning 4xxs (Tom). Can we aim to have PRs by EOD Wed?

Claire: I'll open a redirect PR that adds the old anchor -> new anchor in _redirects.yaml and update the embed file to point to the new page. I'll flag it for quick review.

Ben: I'll open the snippet PR and include the minimal JS/Python pair. Will also add a short line in the migration guide showing the one-line diff for quick scanning.

Tom: Draft known-issue copy: "Heads up: Embeddings calls made with pre-0.9 SDK methods (e.g., jsClient.embed) may return 4xx errors due to the request shape changing. See Embeddings migration guide for upgrade steps." Good?

Priya: Good. I'll assemble the relnotes draft with three bullets: user-facing change, upgrade pointer, and link to migration guide + an internal note about the redirect. Posting for review at 15:00.

docs-bot: Deploy window reminder: docs build runs at 08:00 UTC. Redirects must be merged before 07:30 UTC to make the earliest deploy.
